rulesStrings.li: subject_story->ran data through black markets for a fixer

ResearchProjectDef.label: network security
ResearchProjectDef.description: Guarding the colony's own node. Unlocks the firewall, first-tier defensive ICE and the honeypot mode that lets attackers in on purpose.

ResearchProjectDef.label: neurorecording
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recording what a mind feels, not only what it sees. Unlocks braindance goggles and the neurostabilizer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: active ICE
ResearchProjectDef.description: Defensive programs that strike back. Unlocks second-tier ICE and the cyberpod's "node watch" mode, where a netrunner guards the colony from inside the net.

ResearchProjectDef.label: AI awakening
ResearchProjectDef.description: How to coax a sleeping AI fragment back to life without losing it. Unlocks the AI server and awakening fragments. Fragments can be kept and sold without this.

ResearchProjectDef.label: AI architecture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Homes for more than one mind. Unlocks server racks, the AI coprocessor and the AI socket implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: black ICE defense
ResearchProjectDef.description: The colony's own black ICE: defensive programs that burn an intruder's mind. Unlocks third-tier ICE.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat executables
ResearchProjectDef.description: Packing exec data and ICE breakers into one-shot programs a netrunner can fire during a dive.
